name: 90058 · Vernon, CA
findings: ZIP 90058 (Vernon) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90058 (Vernon) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90058 (Vernon) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 6% of all organizations here have no identified type.
